name: Ринг · opus50 · Метроном
description: A clockwork automaton boxer: a precise, calm, dry, slightly ironic male baritone, middle-low pitch, with a faint metallic resonance, as if the voice rings through a small brass chamber. Clipped, rhythmic delivery: every syllable lands exactly on the beat, as if he speaks in time with a metronome, with short crisp pauses between phrases. Unhurried and cool, never shouts even when exerting, confident with understated dry humor, like a strict old conductor counting the orchestra in. Clean studio recording, close microphone, no music, no background noise. Clear Russian diction.
